examples_zh: 请把这些活动安排写成一份可直接转发的通知，讲清参加事项和办理要求，只给完整通知。
请根据我提供的采购需求、报价和经费情况，起草一份设备采购请示，重点写清采购理由、主要内容和请求批准的事项。
请把本阶段工作记录整理成工作总结，重点写主要进展和代表性成果，合并重复内容，分别交代已有安排和下一步建议。
请把这些会议记录整理成纪要，写清议定事项、责任分工和办理期限，继续讨论的事项单列。
请把这份汇报压缩到800字以内，保留关键事实、数字和原意，删去重复铺陈，语言平实自然，返回完整改后稿。
请审校这份公文，按“位置、问题、修改建议”列出意见，区分明确错误、待核实信息和可选的表达优化。
请根据提案和办理记录起草答复，逐项回应建议，讲清当前进展和后续安排，只给完整答复。
请按申报表栏目整理这些科研或教改项目材料，重点讲清研究问题、具体方法和检验办法，让已有基础支撑本次研究。
examples_en: Turn these activity arrangements into a Chinese notice ready to forward. Explain participation details and required actions, and return only the complete notice.
Use the procurement needs, quotations, and funding information I provide to draft a Chinese request for approval to purchase equipment. Explain the reasons, scope, and approval requested.

Turn my work records for this period into a Chinese work summary. Focus on the main progress and representative results, combine repeated points, and distinguish existing plans from recommendations for next steps.
Turn these meeting notes into formal Chinese minutes. State the agreed items, responsibilities, and deadlines, and list matters for further discussion separately.
Condense this Chinese report to 800 characters or fewer. Preserve its key facts, figures, and meaning, remove repetition, and return the full revised draft in plain, natural Chinese.

Review this Chinese official document. List the location, issue, and suggested revision for each comment, distinguishing definite errors, information needing verification, and optional wording improvements.
Draft a Chinese reply from the proposal and handling records I provide. Address each recommendation, explain current progress and follow-up arrangements, and return only the complete reply.

Organize these research or teaching-reform project materials into the application form's sections in Chinese. Focus on the research problem, methods, and evaluation approach, and connect existing work to the proposed research.
